name: Flower City Cube Fest 2022
information:
Events: 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, Clock, Square-1, and Skewb

**Competitors may bring at most one guest.**

# All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof that they satisfy one of the following two requirements in order to be allowed in the venue:

- **They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19.** To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after **Saturday, July 16** is insufficient for entrance to the competition.

 OR

- **They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition.** The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than **Tuesday, July 26** is insufficient for entrance to the competition.
